Info

Interface protocol for navigating trajectory waypoint selection index.

class scarajectory.core.service.trajectory.plan.selection.iplan_selection_navigator.IPlanSelectionNavigator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural interface protocol for waypoint selection navigation operations.

It defines:

methods:
select_index - Sets selection index directly.
select_last - Selects the last element based on total count.
select_first_or_none - Selects first element or deselects if empty.
reset - Clears selection back to deselected state.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
reset() → None[source]¶

Clears selection back to deselected state (-1).

select_first_or_none(total_count: int) → None[source]¶

Selects first element (0) or -1 if empty.

Parameters:

total_count – Total count of waypoints.

select_index(index: int) → None[source]¶

Sets selection index directly.

Parameters:

index – Target index.

select_last(total_count: int) → None[source]¶

Selects the last element based on total count.

Parameters:

total_count – Total count of waypoints.
